question.prompt: Waitress: Welcome to Mother Mouth café! Here is our menu. What can I get for you? Peter: I am not sure. Your house specialty is coffee, isn't it? Waitress: Yes, we have Caffé Americano, Cappuccino, and Caramel Macchiato etc. Peter: Don't you have something special with wine in it? Waitress: Certainly! I just favor coffee with liqueur. Peter: Um, I'll have __________. Such as Irish coffee, Royal coffee, Mesdames coffee. Waitress: OK, coming right up.
